notes.title: Park Control Simulator Development Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43175009/7ad49d38c3c37fd232aaa06cf2794ec94bde633c.png[/img]
The development of Park Control Simulator was delayed for a long time due to unforeseen circumstances. Today, we are happy to announce that the development of the game has resumed. We have started working on it again with an improved gameplay experience.

We are aware that we have kept you waiting for a long time, and we sincerely apologize for that. However, Park Control Simulator is back in development, and we are delighted to share this news with you.

We will complete the development as soon as possible and bring Park Control Simulator to you with its renewed gameplay.

Thank you for your patience!
